environment.transport: HTTP snapshots, one request per client every 100ms, D1 local emulator
environment.network: Same-machine loopback; not a physical LAN or WAN

definition: Wall time from issuing an HTTP playback command to a polling client receiving its authoritative playback revision. Includes command request and snapshot read. Excludes HTML media rendering.
limitations: Loopback baseline only: physical LAN acceptance test still required.
Browser media drift requires separate playback measurements; core simulation is not a media-decoder measurement.
Cloud deployment latency depends on geographic placement and is not guaranteed by this local measurement.
